context: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki finalize a hiring budget.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: finance/HR meeting; budget vocabulary (税/資金/採用/雇用/確保) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 採用のための資金は、足りているかね?
lines.en: Are the funds for hiring sufficient?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、資金はすでに確保しました。
lines.en: Yes, I've already secured the funds.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 雇用の形は、正社員かね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 採用は、正社員を中心に進めます。
lines.en: We'll center hiring on full-time staff.
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 税の計算は、済んでいるかね?
lines.en: Has the tax calculation been done?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 税を含めて、予算を確保してあります。
lines.en: Including tax, the budget is secured.
lines.style: diligent office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良い雇用が、会社を支えるからな。
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資金を大切に、採用を進めます。
lines.en: I'll advance hiring, treating the funds with care.
lines.style: resolved office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
